topic: Introduction to Neural Networks and Deep Learning
learningObjectives: Identify the main components of an artificial neural network
Understand how neurons, weights, biases, and activation functions work together
Trace data through a basic neural network

activities.title: Neural Network Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click each layer and component to explore its role.

content.concept: A neural network contains connected layers of neurons that transform inputs into outputs using learned parameters.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Build a Neural Network
activities.instruction: Connect neurons and layers to form a basic network.

content.concept: Neural networks combine input, hidden, and output layers to learn representations from data.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Activation Function Lab
activities.instruction: Adjust the input and observe the activation output.

content.concept: Activation functions transform neuron outputs and allow neural networks to model nonlinear relationships.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Forward Pass
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps of data flowing through the network.

content.concept: During a forward pass, input values move through weighted connections and activation functions to produce an output.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
